articleTitle: Research and Comparison of ARIMA and Grey Prediction Models for Subway Traffic Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the increasing development of metro transportation in cities, the accurate prediction of station traffic poses a challenge for data mining and analysis. Machine learning has been gradually applied to various traffic prediction due to its low computational complexity, easy interpretation and accurate prediction results. In this paper, based on ARIMA and the gray prediction model, the data of a city's various subway gates are selected to predict the passenger flow of the subway. Then, the MAE (Mean Absolute Error) is used to compare the differences between the two machine learning algorithms on passenger flow prediction. Finally, this paper discusses the training set and model fitting to provide a technical reference for further improving the prediction performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Patch and Feature Fusion Network for Single Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The dehazing method based on deep learning has made significant progress in the field of image dehazing, but most methods still have the problem of incomplete dehazing and color distortion. To solve this problem, an image dehazing network based on multi-patch and feature fusion is proposed. The network consists of preprocessing, feature extraction, feature fusion and post-processing modules. The preprocessing module can adaptively extract image feature information from the patch. The feature extraction module uses cascaded dense residual blocks to extract deep feature information. The feature fusion module performs channel weighting and pixel weighting on the feature map to achieve the fusion of main features. The post-processing module performs nonlinear mapping on the fused feature map to obtain a dehazing image. Experiments show that this network has achieved ideal dehazing effects on both synthetic and real-world images, and can avoid color distortion after dehazing.

articleTitle: Depth-Wise Convolution with Attention Neural Network (DWA) for Pneumonia Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Pneumonia can lead to necrosis of lung tissue and lung abscess. The further expansion of pneumonia infection can also cause a variety of specific complications. Pneumonia infection can spread to the pleural cavity and cause empyema. It can also lead to pleurisy, endocarditis, pericarditis, arthritis and so on. Accurate detection of pneumonia is very important. This paper proposes Depth-Wise Convolution with Attention neural network (DWA) and a set of automatic pneumonia recognition algorithm based on the deep learning method and the morphology of the lungs. Vgg16, DenseNet, ResNet are excellent models in the field of target detection, they can be trained to achieve classification task. This article uses the same data set and sets the same training parameters during training. Under a unified evaluation criteria, the VGG16, DenseNet, ResNet, and DWA models were evaluated respectively. The experimental results show that DWA has the best performance of the classification (training accuracy of 97.5%, testing accuracy of 96% and validation accuracy of 79%).

articleTitle: A Novel Model for the Traffic of Urban Roads Based on Queuing Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: As traffic forecast is necessary for people travelling, the traffic issue becomes increasingly significant in the urban city. In this paper, we introduce the birth and death process to describe the behaviors of vehicles and then we propose a traffic model based on queueing theory to simulate the traffic on the road. We discuss two situations of the traffic systems which are the stationary state and the congested state. In a stationary state, we deduce statistical variables of the traffic system, the number of vehicles and the waiting time for passing the section of the road, which usefully offers valid information for drivers. Besides, we utilize our model to simulate the traffic and the distribution of vehicle number under stationary of theoretical results as well as simulation results are obtained, which shows the validity of our model.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Assessment for ICS system Based on Zero-day Attack Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The numerous attacks on ICS systems have made severe threats to critical infrastructure. Extensive studies have focussed on the risk assessment of discovering vulnerabilities. However, to identify Zero-day vulnerabilities is challenging because they are unknown to defenders. Here we sought to measure ICS system zero-day risk by building an enhanced attack graph for expected attack path exploiting zero-day vulnerability. In this study, we define the security metrics of Zero-day vulnerability for an ICS. Then we created a Zero-day attack graph to guide how to harden the system by measuring attack paths that exploiting zero-day vulnerabilities. Our studies identify the vulnerability assessment method on ICS systems considering Zero-day Vulnerability by zero-day attack graph. Together, our work is essential to ICS systems security. By assessing unknown vulnerability risk to close the imbalance between attackers and defenders.

articleTitle: Research on Day-ahead Optimal Dispatch Considering the Mutual Constraint of Pumped Storage Unit
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The pumped storage power station is the most widely used energy storage device, which can form an optimized scheduling scheme in conjunction with new energy. It can mitigate the impact of randomness and suddenness of new energy on the stability of the power system. Based on the large deviation of medium and long - term experience dispatching, this paper introduces the day-ahead power market and constructs the day-ahead optimal dispatching model including pumped storage power station. Taking the maximization of the system operation comprehensive benefit as the objective function, in addition to the consideration of conventional constraints, the mutual constraints among units of the pumped storage power station are considered. The method of mixed-integer linear programming is applied to solve the problem by mature commercial software package GLPK. The rationality of the model is verified by a provincial power grid with 4 pumped storage units.

articleTitle: Sparse representation and reconstruction of image based on K-SVD dictionary learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: K-Singular Value Decomposition (K-SVD) is an excellent feature analysis method, but it has a large amount of calculation and low algorithm efficiency. To solve the above problems, a dictionary learning method for image block classification training is proposed. This method uses image entropy as the classification index of image samples, selects more complex texture image blocks with more analytical value, and uses Discrete Cosine Transform- Discrete Wavelet Transformation (DCT-DWT) dictionary to train them in K-Singular Value Decomposition. Through the feedback of sparse coefficients, the threshold value is dynamically changed and the precision of sparse coding is controlled. In the sparse solution, a variable-step Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) algorithm is used. The experimental comparison shows that the classification K-Singular Value Decomposition dictionary learning algorithm runs faster, and the Peak signal-to-noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity (SSIM) value of the reconstructed image are higher.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Control Based on Smart Grid Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: At the same time, the burning of a large amount of fossil fuels has aggravated environmental pollution and the greenhouse effect. In order to solve the problems of energy shortage and environmental pollution, electric vehicle technology has been highly valued by many countries. Electric vehicles are the most promising new energy vehicles. Therefore, on the basis of fully considering the charging load characteristics of electric vehicles, how to better establish charging facilities and adjust the impact of a large number of random loads on the grid. Therefore, it is of great significance and application value to study the charging strategy and control method of electric vehicles to improve the stable operation level of the power grid and the ability to accept new energy. Here, the frequency modulation control strategy of electric vehicles considering the restriction of electricity price is studied to ensure the regulation ability and charging demand of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Path Planning Based on Artificial Potential Field and Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: An improved artificial potential field method is proposed aiming at the problems of local minimization and trajectory oscillation of traditional artificial potential field method in complex environment. When the mobile robot falls into the local minimum position, set the virtual target by analyzing the angle between the robot and obstacles to guide the robot escape from the dead zone. A fuzzy controller is designed to improve the problem of trajectory oscillation, which outputs the environment danger factor to adjust the step size of robot and enhance the trajectory smoothness of robot in complex environment. Simulation results show that the proposed method can achieve good collision avoidance effect in the environment with liner or U-shaped obstacle and a large number of discrete obstacles, and effectively improve the trajectory oscillation in complex environment.

articleTitle: Research and prediction of Shanghai-Shenzhen 20 Index Based on the Support Vector Machine Model and Gradient Boosting Regression Tree
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The non-stationarity, non-linearity and multi-factor influence of financial index series makes it more difficult to predict. In order to achieve a more accurate stock index prediction, this paper selects a public data set provided by a well-known securities company to predict the CSI 20 Index (CSI20) based on the gradient-enhancing regression tree model and support vector machine model. RMSE, MAE, and MAPE are selected as the indicators to evaluate the differences in the forecasting ability of the two models in the financial sector. The results of this study can help investors to adopt effective investment strategies and reduce investment risks.

articleTitle: On the use of ant colony algorithm with weighted penalty strategy to optimize path searching
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The heuristic algorithm has been commonly used in solving the shortest path optimization problem. Recently, the ant colony algorithm is a bionic algorithm with decent performance. This paper proposed an improved ant colony algorithm with weighted penalty strategy to shorten path searching distance. Firstly, the grid method is used to transform the target area into a two-dimensional environment model, and the traditional ant colony algorithm is used to plan the path on the grid environment model. Secondly, shortest path obtained by Dijkstra algorithm is compared with that of the ant colony algorithm to validate its effectiveness. Finally, a weighted penalty strategy is proposed and implemented within ant colony algorithm. The advantage of this proposed algorithm enables the ant colony search to set higher priority on those close to the optimal path, and set lower priority on the undesired path. The weighted strategy has been simulated in MATLAB and it is demonstrated the distance of the optimal path is shorten effectively compared to traditional ant colony algorithm.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm-optimized BP neural network model for prediction of soil heavy metal content in XRF
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the quantitative analysis of XRF (X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy) for predicting trace heavy metal elements in soil, there are large errors in data analysis due to background interference and signal interference of neighboring elements. This paper proposed a hybrid algorithm, which optimizes the weights and thresholds of the BP neural network by using Genetic Algorithm, so as to study the intrinsic relationship between the element's component information and content. The presented hybrid algorithm is used for quantitative analysis of four heavy metal elements Pb, Mn, Cr, and Cu in soil. Firstly, the X fluorescence spectra of 57 standard soil samples were obtained using a portable X fluorescence analyzer, and the discrete wavelet was used for denoising and background deduction to improve the signal-to-noise ratio. Then, the component information of four heavy metals and some other elements that might interfere with them are obtained by using Compton's normalization method, which are respectively taken as the inputs of the model, and the actual contents of Pb, Mn, Cr, and Cu are respectively taken as the outputs, so as to establish a three-layer BP neural network with one implicit layer. Finally, the training results of the model show that there is a good overlap between the predicted data and the expected one which verifies that the method is effective for the quantitative analysis of trace heavy metal elements in the soil.

articleTitle: A Travel Assistant Application Based on Android Baidu Map
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: It is very necessary to develop applications running on mobile phones because Mobile Internet and smart phones are playing an increasingly important role in tourism. Although Android Baidu map provides basic map data, the services for Guilin tourism are still limited. To solve this problem, a travel assistant application (APP) for Guilin based on Android Baidu Map and Java language is designed and developed. The APP uses SQLite Embedded Database to store tourism information, and uses Android Baidu Map SDK package to obtain the data in Baidu Map database as tourism map information, which will be loaded into the APP for interface display. The design of request permission, SQLite database, APP page layout and specific functions are carried out for the App. Combined with the Service1, Service2 and Service3 of Android Baidu Map SDK, the APP specific functions such as map display, map positioning, geocoding, Point of Interest (POI) retrieval, route planning, navigation and route POI information are implemented to help users obtain more convenient and quick tourism information services.

articleTitle: Aggregation Control for Distributed Energy Storage in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: At present, large amount distributed energy storages (DESs) connected to the distribution network lack of effective scheduling methods. An centralized control strategy of DESs with random access and output can be utilized to realize the aggregation control of large amount DESs, which can improve the stability, efficiency and economy of the distribution network. Due to the application of DESs have not yet been configured in large amounts, the research on the aggregation of DES is few. Based on the aggregation mechanism of DES, this paper proposes an aggregation control algorithm of DESs. The simulation explains the specific method of the proposed aggregation control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Intraday Rolling Optimal Dispatch Including Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Based on the intraday trading of power spot market and the current operation mode of pumped storage power station, a rolling coordinated dispatching strategy for new energy and pumped storage combined power generation system is proposed. After pumped storage power plants enter the power market. Taking the maximum overall benefit of the joint system as the objective function, a 0 -1 mixed-integer linear programming model with pumped storage participating in intra-day rolling optimal scheduling is constructed. The analysis part of the calculation example takes a provincial power grid as an example. Based on the unit operation plan made the day before the operation, the ultra-short-term prediction information updated in real-time was used to conduct rolling correction and clear the planned operation curve of the next period. The results show that the new energy is well absorbed after the pumped storage power station participates in the intraday market, which makes the system operator obtain greater overall expected income.

articleTitle: Lightweight semantic segmentation algorithm based on MobileNetV3 network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the popularization of intelligent terminals, more and more image segmentation tasks need to be carried out on mobile terminals. However, due to the limitation of mobile terminal computing and storage capacity, many classical semantic segmentation network models are too large to be applicable to mobile terminals. Therefore, this paper proposes a lightweight semantic segmentation algorithm based on the improved MobileNetV3 network. First, the leaky-ReLU6 activation function presented in this article was applied to the first seven layers of the MobileN etV3 network, and then the improved MobileNetV3 was used as an encoder for feature extraction. Then, the decoder part uses bilinear interpolation and depth separable convolution. Finally, the jump connection structure is retained to fuse the features of the lower layer and the higher layer. By comparing the network proposed in this paper with classic networks such as FCN, SegNet, UNet and DeepLabV3+, it is found that the network designed in this paper can effectively guarantee the segmentation accuracy, greatly reduce the number of parameters and shorten the running time of the network. It can be better applied to the mobile terminal with tight computing resources and space resources.

articleTitle: Application of Genome Sequence Based on Entropy Coding
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: A novel genome sequence entropy coding algorithm based Context modeling is proposed. In this paper, the genome sequence data of bioinformatics features is sliced and reformed into 4 clusters according with biological meanings: the coding sequence cluster, the intron cluster, the RNA cluster and the residual cluster. According to the specific biological characteristics of the sequences in each set were pretreated respectively, then the sequences are compressed with entropy coding algorithm. The experiment shows that it is a good method to deal with the problem that than original DNA compression algorithms of the long DNA sequences, so it can make compression ratio and entropy coding efficient higher.

articleTitle: Application of 3D tracking and registration in exhibition hall navigation interaction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Augmented reality technology provides new development ideas for the visualization of data information, and at the same time provides new development space for the convergence of digital visualization technology and multiple industries. The traditional exhibition hall visit mode is single and limited by region and the number of visitors. In response to such problems, this article develops a handheld mobile terminal AR exhibition hall navigation application based on augmented reality technology. The article mainly elaborates on the principle of 3D tracking registration technology and its realization method in the development of exhibition hall navigation interactive application development. The 3D model scene of the exhibition hall is constructed based on the environmental data of the real scene, and Vuforia is used for 3D tracking registration and registration of the real scene. Target positioning, use augmented reality development technology to create system navigation interactive function modules, break the barriers of time and space, achieve the superposition and integration of virtual and reality, complete application development and test analysis. The test results show that the AR exhibition hall navigation application developed by using 3D tracking registration technology has good interactivity and ease of use, and can provide new solutions for the future exhibition and navigation of the smart cultural tourism industry.

articleTitle: The Signal Intelligent Analysis System of Eventlog
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper describes the composition of the Eventlog of Guangzhou Pumped Storage Power Station, and based on it, to further study the signal intelligent analysis system of Eventlog. The Eventlog information intelligent analysis system can extract abnormal non-alarm signals from a large amount of data by extracting the Eventlog signals and using Excel VBA to carry out intelligent mining analysis on the signals, thus providing important references for the maintenance of unit equipment, daily management and even the selection of unit operation mode. This paper also uses practical examples to prove the huge effect of the system in analyzing the Non-alarm signals.

articleTitle: Research on Gravity Compensation in Motion Control of Multi-joint Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Since the robot system is a system with strong coupling and many uncertain factors, there are many problems in the robot control, and the error problem in the process of robot trajectory tracking control is one of the most important problems. This paper proposes a novel gravity compensation method for the six-degree-of-freedom robot. First the kinematics and dynamics models of the robot system are established, and the running trajectory is generated by polynomial interpolation. Then the changes in the gravity workspace in the robot dynamics model and the influence of the gravity moment on the robot pose are analyzed. Based on the establishment of robot dynamics and kinematics model, a gravity feedforward compensation PD control method is designed. In this method, gravity compensation term is introduced on the basis of PD controller, which can effectively solve the tracking error problem caused by the gravity of each joint link of the robot. The simulation results show that the PD control method of gravity feedforward compensation based on the robot model can effectively improve the accuracy of the system trajectory tracking under the premise of the accurate compensation model, and it has good response characteristics and tracking ability.

articleTitle: On the use of higher-density wavelet packet neighboring coefficient to improve SNR for signal denoising
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Wavelet denoising is an effective method to eliminate heavy background noise and has been widely utilized to extract useful characteristic signal information. However, the traditional higher-density wavelet transform has one scale function and two wavelet functions overlapping in frequency domain, which causes detailed signal extraction problems. In this paper, a novel method called higher-density wavelet packet neighboring coefficient denoising algorithm is proposed to extract the detailed signal information located in the middle and high frequency bands furtherly. Firstly, higher-density wavelet packet transform is adopted to achieve more sophisticated division of the target signal frequency band. Secondly, neighboring coefficient denoising method is implemented to extract more characteristic signals since they tend to be concentrated in adjacent coefficients. Finally, the proposed algorithm is simulated and verified by periodic impact signals coupled with random noise. It is demonstrated that the proposed method can improve signal-to-noise ratio greatly and extract more characteristic signals.

articleTitle: Cooperative benefit allocation for domestic electricity of smart communities based on coalitional game theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Each household in the smart community may have distributed wind power/distributed photovoltaic/distributed energy storage and other power generation resources. With the help of advanced sensing, communication, and computing technologies in the smart community, the cooperative power consumption of smart community households can be realized, thus the efficient use of distributed resources in the smart community and the improvement of power utilization efficiency can be realized. The establishment of a smart community household cooperative power optimization model has quantified the benefit of the efficient utilization of distributed power generation resources brought about by the cooperation of household electricity consumption. Based on the coalitional game theory, the proportional allocation method, the nucleolus allocation method, the Shapley value method and the bargaining allocation method are used to allocate the cooperative benefit of household electricity consumption. Finally, an example is used to verify the effectiveness and rationality of the cooperative electricity benefit allocation method.

articleTitle: A New Signature Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: For E-commerce scenes like online transaction or online lottery, security issues arises on anonymity protection for legal users and traceability on illegal ones. This paper introduces a new blockchain-based signature scheme to provide both anonymity and traceability. This scheme requires a credible center to distribute initial private key and to add public key for each user, who can sign at any public key belonging to them. Compared to PKI, it enables verifiers checking validity of signers' public keys in certain blocks without looking up entire certificate list. Unlike Identity-based cryptography, this solution also keeps each user's identity anonymous to other users since the identity is only known by the user and the credible center.

articleTitle: Research and Improvement of Asymmetrical Magnetic Coupler of Inspection Robot Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Asymmetrical magnetic couplers are often applied in the wireless charging system of inspection robots with strong misalignment adaptability. When a specific range misalignment occurs on the receiving coil, the mutual inductance between the transmitting coil and the receiving coil remains almost constant, thereby ensuring stable power transmission. However, since the bottom chassis of the inspection robot is made of aluminum, it will affect the original asymmetric magnetic coupler's magnetic field distribution and thus lose the effect of mutual inductance stability. This paper analyzes the failure mechanism of a uniform magnetic field caused by metal and improves the original magnetic coupler on this basis to restore the stability of mutual inductance.

articleTitle: 3D Modeling and Visualization of River Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of 3D modeling technology, hydrology of rivers can be simulated and visualized in computer. This paper focuses on visualization and 3D modeling for river systems. Data set of physical properties such as longitude, latitude and depth are used to create a 3D model for a river. We use grid interpolation to generate missing data, curvature comparison and bounding box to extract feature points to create 3D models. The similarity of models is compared by converting 3D models to 2D views. The experimental result shows that an appropriate bounding box can extract feature points from the raw data and obtain accurate 3D models. Finally, we import the 3D model into Blender to further visualize the river system with bank, plants and water waves.

articleTitle: Discussion on lightning protection of distribution network and its differentiation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The distribution network serves as a connection hub with users in the power system, supplying electric energy to users or factories, and has a close relationship with users. As individuals have higher requirements for the quality, reliability and economy of electric energy, the safety and reliability of the distribution network is getting increasing number of attention. Due to the low insulation level of distribution lines, harsh operating environment in some areas, complex network structure, and susceptibility to lightning strikes, the majority of the current researches give priority to transmission lines, thus the lightning protection of the distribution network needs to be focused. Although there are quite a few kinds of lightning protection measures, it is difficult to find a universal lightning protection measure in the distribution network. For the lightning protection measures of the distribution network, specific problems need to be analyzed in detail, and they are suitable for local conditions. Here we discuss the scientific and effective design of lightning protection schemes through “active lightning protection”, “passive lightning protection” and “differential lightning protection” to improve the lightning protection efficiency of the distribution network and ensure the safe and reliable operation of the system.

articleTitle: Realtime Multi-Person Pose Estimation Based on Android System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Human pose estimation has always been a very popular direction. This technology can be applied to human-computer interaction, abnormal behavior detection, intelligent security and other fields, and it will promote the development of artificial intelligence in the future. Human pose estimation has been developed for a long time, and with the advancement of science and technology, many emerging algorithms have spewed out, but most of these algorithms use a multistage network structure. These network structures have achieved better results in accuracy, but the parameters have become larger and larger. It's a big problem that deploying these networks to mobile and embedded devices with limited system resources. We use the MobileNet and TensorFlow Lite frameworks launched by Google to successfully optimize the complex network model and deploy it to Android phones. The human pose estimation can be quickly realized only by using local calculations, avoiding the delay trouble caused by cloud computing solutions.

articleTitle: Research on Computer-Generated Force Perceptual Attention
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Perception model is an important research field of CGF behavior modeling. As the input of the reasoning module, whether the information obtained from the perception model is precise is of great significance for the simulation fidelity. This paper first investigates the related researches on CGF perception model, and focuses on analyzing the attention mechanism, action time, and action way. Besides, a virtual human perception framework based on attention mechanism is proposed by constructing the knowledge base of the attention and modeling of information feedback mechanism. Compared to the traditional perception model, the proposed framework is more effective to capture and deal with the information from simulation environment.

articleTitle: The Security Threat of Adversarial Samples to Deep Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the prosperity of artificial intelligence, research on machine learning becomes a hot issue globally. Generative Adversarial Networks expose the huge security risks of machine learning. After the creation, GAN has achieved good performance in image generation, automatic image coloring, and data enhancement. With the improvement of the ability to generate samples against the deep learning network, generating malicious samples against the target learning model to achieve the deceptive discriminator becomes an effective and harmful attacking method. At present, some efficient attack methods have been proposed for different types of learning networks and different types of sample data. This paper mainly discusses the vulnerability of deep learning networks and several attack methods based on adversarial samples.

articleTitle: Summary on Thangka Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Image segmentation is a basic task in the field of computer vision and image processing. At present, researchers use existing image segmentation technology to analyze and detect Thangka images, extract interesting objects, or obtain potential damaged areas to repair damaged areas in the next step. This article mainly introduces the traditional image segmentation algorithm, the current popular Deep learning algorithm, and the application of these algorithms in Thangka image processing. Although the structure of the Thangka image is relatively simple, it is rich in color information and complex in texture. It is particularly important to find a suitable method for segmenting the Thangka image. At present, the application in the special field of image processing still needs further in-depth research, which is the future development trend.

articleTitle: Bypass operation combined with short-bar insulation bridge operation method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid increase in user power demand, the maintenance of high-voltage lines often results in users in an area being unable to use electricity normally, which has a great impact on life and production, so the uninterrupted power operation method is becoming more and more important. Traditional live work is mainly divided into insulating rod and insulating glove operation methods. Bypass operation combined with short-bar insulation bridge operation method can reduce the risk and difficulty of operation to a greater extent, and is more universal.

articleTitle: Shopping Mall Stores Planning Using K-means
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Shopping mall is a concentrated and mature commercial district that is usually located at a city's central area. It is a necessary district for every modern city. As the main components of shopping malls, stores' management and arrangement will heavily influence customers' experience. With a large number of stores in the shopping mall, it is a challenging task to properly design and manage the whole shopping mall. However, with the help of machine learning, we are able to analyze vast amount of data and use the result to help us with the store arrangement and management. In this paper, we will use the machine learning technique to classify the stores of a shopping mall by the transaction data of each stores. This result provides us with insights about the shopping mall planning, arrangement and management, allowing us to form functional districts within a shopping mall appropriately.

articleTitle: Automatic liver segmentation using U-net in the assistance of CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Liver segmentation is widely used in medicine for volumetric or morphological analysis. This paper presents a system to automatically segment liver from the CT scans for real clinical application. The proposed system uses one of the most suitable networks in biomedical segmentation U-net in the assistance of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The preprocessed CT scans with and without liver are divided into five position groups and labelled with group number. In the next step, we train CNN for automatic localization of the CT scans. Afterwards, three networks based on U-net are fed with images in the same group having liver and then trained for liver segmentation separately. The proposed system is evaluated on the scans from LiTS2017 and 3Dircadb database. The average IOU score improves to 92.8% compared with state-of-the-art. Meanwhile, the novel system demonstrates its flexibility in the choice of training data and its universality in testing data, which is suitable for both scans with liver and scans without liver. The experimental results indicate that the proposed system facilitates the procedure of liver segmentation and has its potential for accurate liver segmentation for clinical application.

articleTitle: A reversible data hiding approach based on filter selection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In prediction-error-expansion and pixel sorting based reversible data hiding (RDH) works, only part of the neighboring pixels are used in pixel prediction and local complexity calculation. To fully exploit the local correlations, we propose a novel efficient RDH using filter selection. Firstly, we divide the cover image into multiple non-overlapping layers following the concept of image down-sampling. Then data is embedded in a layer-wise manner. For data embedding, the prediction-error and the local complexity are estimated using the idea of block-based image filtering, the related techniques of which have been widely studied in the area of image processing. Experimental results validate the applicability of the proposed work in the perspectives of both embedding capacity and image quality.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Big Data Technology in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The application of big data has been widely adopted today, but the exploration of Energy Internet based on the big data is in its early phase. In the paper, firstly, the basic concept, characteristic and method of big data is described, and the current situation of Energy Internet is investigated. Then, the importance and implementation means of big data in Energy Internet is pointed out. Several application scenarios of big data used for Energy Internet are presented, and the advantage of big data is summarized. Finally, the application technology system and research framework of big data in Energy Internet are proposed.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of power cable monitoring platform based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Optical cable remote precise monitoring is a long-term problem to be solved in power system. As the main bearing medium of long-distance signal transmission, the monitoring level directly determines the stability of power system lines. Optical fiber is easy to be affected by external interference, which causes the change of internal characteristics. Traditional methods generally use OTDR monitoring technology to determine the location and cause of optical fiber fault, but the monitoring accuracy of single parameter will be reduced, especially in the face of complex external environment. It is easy to cause line switching misoperation due to misjudgment. This paper designs a multi parameter optical fiber monitoring system and data analysis platform based on big data. Through the reasonable definition and orderly management of data structure and processing mode, the software and hardware architecture, functions and services of the system are studied and designed one by one. The comprehensive supervision and data service of optical cable resources on the same platform are realized, which greatly improves the resource management of optical cable operation and maintenance personnel Efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of RB Allocation in LTE
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: According to the LTE protocol, there are three resource allocation types for downstream RB, each of which has both advantages and disadvantages with a fixed allocation method. However, in different scenarios, the resource allocation types took by users are different. By researching both advantages and disadvantages of these three types of resource allocation above, this paper proposes a two-step combination method to calculate the RB allocated to each user in the scheduling process, that is, first of all the amount is allocated, and then the RB number is determined to allocate to users by calculating RB position. This allocation method can reasonably makes good use of the advantages of different types of resources allocation, avoiding shortcomings, and can be a good combination of three types of resource allocation. Finally living examples prove that this scheme is feasible.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Storage Aggregator for Power System Frequency Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the large amount configuration of distributed energy storage (DES), the randomness of its output and access point will challenge the traditional operation mode of power grid. If DES is connected to the power system in disorder as a random disturbance power source, it will have a negative impact on the power quality, and will cause the unreasonable utilization of energy storage resources. However, the economy of power system operation can be improved by regulating the idle DESs to provide auxiliary services for the demand of power system. In this paper, a control strategy of distributed energy storage aggregator (DESA) to participate in the power system frequency control is proposed. The aggregation of DESs is based on the analytic hierarchy process structure. By integrating the DES Aggregator into the power system load frequency control, the frequency regulation ability is improved. Case studies verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: An Improved Ant Colony Optimization for Large Scale Colored Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Colored traveling salesman problem (CTSP) is a variant of TSP. Some algorithms have been used to solve CTSP, but the traditional algorithms for this problem are easy to fall into local optimum solution. In the fields such as intelligent transport systems and multi-task cooperation, many problems can be modeled by CTSP, the scale of constructed model is easy to tend to large scale, thus it is necessary to study large scale CTSP. Aiming at the problem, this paper applies an improved ant colony optimization (IACO) algorithm by ITÔ process to solve large scale CTSP. Firstly, a probability generating model of feasible solution for CTSP, is constructed by ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm, then the algorithm designs the pheromone updating strategy based on ITÔ process for optimizing the solution. The experiments show that IACO can demonstrate an improvement over the compared algorithms.

articleTitle: An Improved M/T Speed Algorithm Based on RISC-V DSP
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Speed estimate is a significant argument for motor control system. With the professional SoC, various speed algorithms for incremental encoders have been proposed. In this work, a new speed algorithm based on RISC-V DSP is designed for better accuracy. Compared with traditional methods, this algorithm can effectively eliminate errors caused by unaligned problems and keep the precision in a high level in mostly full speed range.

articleTitle: Dynamic SPA-Markov Evaluation Model of Operation Safety for Terminal Area Airspace System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of uncertainties in operation safety evaluation for terminal area airspace system, Set Pair Analysis (SPA) and Markov chain are combined to propose a dynamic evaluation model for operation safety in terminal area airspace system. In the model, firstly, on the basis of system analysis theory, the operation safety evaluation index system is established for terminal area airspace system, then based on this the conception and definition about relationship degree in SPA is adopted to describe the safety level and change characteristics of operation safety in terminal area airspace system, finally the safety state transition probability matrix is determined by Markov chain to predict the dynamic change tendency in operation safety for terminal area airspace system. The actual example on Shanghai terminal area shows that, the proposed model can accurately describe the dynamic change characteristics of operation safety for terminal area airspace system. This verifies its effectiveness and feasibility.

articleTitle: Oil field distribution network motor cluster pulsating power complementation and grid loss energy-saving optimization method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The power flow of distribution network of oilfield is affected by the period pulsation of pumping unit and shows the characteristic of random fluctuation. The line loss of the distribution network can be effectively reduced by adopting the method of pulsating power complementary control to the motor clusters. Pulsating power complementary principles for oilfield distribution network are proposed and analyzed. The theoretical simulation model of oilfield power distribution network is built. The simulation results show that the line loss of distribution network can be reduced by 38% by using the method of pulsating power complementary of motor cluster. Moreover, many problems are resolved effectively, such as voltage fluctuation of oilfield distribution network, low power supply quality, etc.

articleTitle: An Approach for Suppressing the Grid-Connection Fluctuation of a DFIG Based on Wu Elimination Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: For decreasing the influence of high frequency switch harmonics on the stability of a DFIG, the relationship between the switch angles and modulation ratio of the excitation converter was studied with the help of mechanized mathematics-WEM (Wu Elimination Method). The expression of the switch angles and the modulation ratio was obtained off line and used to control the rotor excitation converter on line. It indicates that the no-ideal modulation ratio that would induce nonlinear dynamics response of the converter bridge can be avoided. The practicability of this approach has been verified by the simulation results achieved by proposed simulation model of the DFIG. It may provide some reference for smoothen the fluctuation of output power of a wind generator system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Regional Energy Consumption Based on Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Association rule is an important analysis method of data mining, combined with the particularity of energy industry, this paper applies association rule to the analysis of regional energy consumption. The energy consumption and its influencing factors in 30 regions (provinces/autonomous regions/municipalities directly under the central government) in China are mined and analyzed by using the method of association rules comprehensive mining based on FP-growth algorithm. The association rules between energy consumption and regional population scale, regional climate, regional GDP and its growth rate, the proportion of regional secondary industry, regional per capita GDP and other factors are obtained. The results are of high reference value, quantitative association rules can predict the trend of regional energy consumption growth. The analysis of influencing factors can provide theoretical reference for regional energy conservation development.

articleTitle: Current Dispersion Characteristics of Grounding Electrode under Different Environments
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The grounding electrode plays a vital role in the UHVDC transmission project. The good current dispersion characteristic of the grounding electrode can provide a guarantee for the stable operation of the power system. In this paper, the finite element method is used to simulate the current dispersion characteristics of linear grounding electrodes in single-layer, three-layer, and mixed-layer soil models. Secondly, the grounding electrode setup for three typical soil models was built in the laboratory. An innovative grounding electrode current measurement scheme based on Hall sensors is used to measure surface current in different soil models. Finally, the measured current distribution characteristics are consistent with the simulation, and the measurement error of the current under this scheme is less than 10%. The grounding electrode current measurement scheme proposed in this paper can provide a certain reference significance for grounding electrode construction projects, and plays a good monitoring role in the operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Image Compressive Sensing via Multi-scale Feature Extraction and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed an end-to-end deep learning-based image compressive sensing framework. Our framework can adaptively sample original images and use linear and nonlinear transformation to reconstruct images. Multi-scale attention block (MAB), which adopts channel attention mechanism and multi-scale feature extraction, is applied in our network to extract meaningful features for recovering high frequency information. Deep supervision is also applied in the training stage to further enhance the reconstruction quality. Experimental simulation shows our framework has a competitive reconstruction performance compared with some classic methods.

articleTitle: Application of ray detection technology in landmark visual interaction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the popularity of smart phones, augmented reality technology has also developed rapidly in recent years. Based on the Unity 3D game engine, this article uses augmented reality technology to interact and display architectural models. First, briefly introduce the development of augmented reality technology and the design process of this article, then mainly introduce the two key augmented reality technologies used in this article, and finally explain the application of Unity 3D, AR ground recognition and gesture recognition and control to build architectural models The overall process of interaction is shown and tested. The test shows that augmented reality technology can be used to display other characteristic architectural models. Through its unique experience and interaction, it can play a role in displaying local characteristic buildings and promoting local traditional culture.

articleTitle: A design scheme for maintenance training simulating system of airborne weapons
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The aircraft aviation weapons and management integrated simulation training system is a simulation system of centralized control/distributed management/information interaction and integrated display. It consists of a simulated airframe/real external equipment/weapon management sub-simulation system and weapon simulator, which can simulate the whole process of aircraft weapon protection and maintenance, and realize the management control and maintenance of weapons (simulation), security training and training evaluation. It can simulate the whole process of aircraft weapon support and maintenance, and realize the functions of weapon (simulation) management control and maintenance support training and training evaluation.

articleTitle: Service Reliability Assurance Technology Based on N-X Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, reliability assessment technology based on N-X service impact analysis is studied to accurately evaluate the risk value of power communication network service under N-X maintenance mode when the maintenance object is in maintenance state. On this basis, N-X service risk analysis is studied under the maintenance mode. Under the maintenance condition, the link or node equipment is determined to be in the maintenance state through maintenance, and the service route will be changed accordingly. All the link and node equipment that cannot be repaired are given to complete the maintenance task with low risk. Study the service reliability assurance technology based on N-X risk, develop the evaluation indexes related to network service protection, simulate the network fault X in the network, statistically evaluate the affected situation of the service, and carry out routing and protection upgrade and optimization for the service affected by the over-threshold or fault.

articleTitle: Data Cleaning of Irrelevant Images Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Considering that there are many irrelevant images in the image data set crawled from the Internet, this paper proposes a new method of cleaning irrelevant images data based on transfer learning. The method consists of two steps that can be done iteratively. Firstly, we use transfer learning to train and get a better image classifier, which makes the single image's recognition effect more accurate. Besides, according to the number of different types of images in the data set, we calculate and determine the threshold value of the image of the minority class and then clean them accordingly. We find that our method can improve the test accuracy of the original data set on VGG16, VGG19, and Inception v3 from 37.41%, 40.62%, and 49.37% to 50.07%, 53.89%, and 65.16%, respectively. Since transfer learning has a good application effect on irrelevant images cleaning, we can use it to create data sets in deep learning.

articleTitle: Waste Sorting System Using Binarized Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Garbage classification is of great importance to reduce environmental pollution and resource waste. For the sake of realizing efficient waste sorting and treatment, we propose a low latency automatic waste sorting system, which can classify garbage into the four categories: recyclable, harmful, kitchen and other garbage, and put the classified garbage into a corresponding garbage can. The system is in a standby state and does not perform any action when there is no garbage. For classifying garbage accurately, we customize an appropriative garbage sorting model based on a binarized neural network (BNN), and it is a small and low complexity network structure deployed to resource-limited embedded devices. To improve the energy efficiency of the system, we design a coprocessor dedicated to accelerating BNN on FPGA. The experiment shows that the classification accuracy of the model reaches 96.8% in the dataset we collected. The coprocessor is 5x better performance and 285x higher energy efficiency than NVIDIA GTX 1060. The system can sort 20 kinds of garbage, and the average execution time of the system is 1.3 seconds.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Driven Dialogue Management for Task-oriented Dialogue
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Task-oriented dialogue systems have received much attention nowadays. As a core part of the dialogue system, dialogue management often uses a set of predefined slots to represent the dialogue state and decides what to reply to users. However, due to the flat and independent structure between different slots, it is difficult for the system to handle complex dialogue tasks. Besides, the slots are usually coded by human expert for specific task domain, which is hard for domain migration. This paper implements a knowledge graph-driven dialog management method, which introduces the knowledge graph to represent the dialogue state instead of slots. In order to solve the problem of excessive dialogue state space, we investigate a hierarchical entangled state tracking method, which can handle complex conversation and is easy for domain migration. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on two different dialogue tasks of electricity account application and electricity purchasing.

articleTitle: A numerical solution method for over-damped fractional Langevin equation based on predictive correction approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Stochastic resonance (SR) is a signal processing method that uses noise to enhance the energy of weak signals. This feature makes it show great potential application value in various fields. Moreover, the memory effect on the past state in time also allows SR to achieve better application and development in the fractional order system. Currently, most of the solutions to fractional SR systems use block diagram simulation methods which are based on the Simulink environment. The simulation solution method solves the system model by putting the fractional calculus into the complex frequency domain, but the complicated calculation and low efficiency make it unable to be conveniently applied to engineering practice. Therefore, this paper proposes a numerical solution method based on predictive correction approach for this problem, and the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Monitoring and Controlling the Health State of the Oil Pipeline Based on Neighboring Stable Equilibrium Point Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to satisfy imperative requirement of the monitoring and control of the health state, an approach that can be used to estimate and control the fluid pressure of an oil pipeline has been proposed based on the neighboring stable equilibrium point theory. The core work is to modelling the flow dynamic equation of the oil pipeline and by which one the mathematic mechanism for identifying and controlling the fluid pressure can be given. A framework procedure which can be used to monitor and control the pressure and the temperature of the oil pipeline has been derived based on analyzing the relationship of the fluid pressure to the fluid velocity and sampled surface temperature off line. Actual experiment shows that the fluid pressure can be controlled within safety threshold by changing the oil temperature which associated with the heating current and realized by developed heating inverter. It can provide a reference for monitoring and controlling the health state of an oil pipeline.

articleTitle: Haawking IQmath: A mathematical function library for the fixed-point Processor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Haawking RISC-V IQmath is a mathematical function library for C/C++ programmers to seamlessly integrate the fixed-point digital Signal Processor (DSP) chip DSC28×, greatly reducing development time. The Haawking IQmath library is mainly used for high-speed, high-precision real-time computations that can be performed much faster and with comparable precision than the equivalent code written in floating-point format C language, which is important for the design of demanding real-time control systems.

articleTitle: The real time modeling and design of multiple vector vehicles combination
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper introduces a new type of deformable aerial robot, which is based on our redesigned vector vehicle, using the new vector vehicle as a single unit for free combination in the air, different combinations will produce different characteristics to meet various requirements. For example, the horizontal combination of vehicle can make the combined robot one more degree of freedom, and through some special combination methods, the combined robot can speed up and increase the degree of freedom. In the further algorithm research on problem for the free combination of multiple vector vehicles in the air, the first issue is to establish the mathematical model of the vector vehicle group after the free splicing in the air, which is obtained through the communication between the magnet contacts on the vehicles. Second, in order to obtain the geometric center of the newly constructed robot, the coordinate system is constructed with the mother machine as the center. Third, we use Newton-Euler equation to model the new combination of robot. The real-time mathematical model of any number and combination of vehicles can be obtained by using this method, which has important applications in the splicing and separation of vehicle.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Internet Architecture Based on Cloud Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the application of cloud computing technology in Energy Internet, this paper introduces the work and research on the theory and practice of Energy Internet from the current situation at home and abroad. Then, this paper summarizes the data types and data sources in the Energy Internet. Based on the Summingbird real-time data processing platform, the paper proposes a practical cloud computing platform for the Energy Internet, and analyzes the feasibility and advantages of the Summingbird platform for the Energy Internet. Finally, based on cloud computing technology, an information system architecture of “wide area cloud” and “local area cloud” is proposed, which can play a crucial role in the Energy Internet.

articleTitle: Electrical Power System Equipment Account Recommendation Technology Based on the User Portrait
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Based on the user portrait, electrical power system equipment account recommendation technology is proposed in this paper. The operation behavior of users and the users information of the power equipment account are used to outline the user portrait in this technology. User portrait and user organization structure are used to optimize the recommendation of power equipment account data. The synonymordlista is provided for electric equipment account data based the perspective of electric power professional application and electric power professional users. The quantification method and coding technology of user information field of power equipment account data, user behavior in user task, in collection and in detail page are provided. It provides an effective solution for the formation of the middle data table of real-time user portrait and the data search of power equipment account.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Compatibility of Non-Contact Slip Ring
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Compared to traditional contact power transfer by slip ring, the wireless power transfer applied to slip ring has more advantages which could reudce the mechanical wear and improve the reliability. In this paper, the crystalline nanocrystalline is proved to have a higher electromagnetic compatibility in slip ring compared with other various magnetic meterials. Meanwhile, the structure design of non-contact slip ring also is discussed in this paper. And the simulation results show that the thickness and open hole caliber of shiled has weak influence for mutual inductance between primary and secondary coils.

articleTitle: Comparing Recommendation Algorithms in Session-based E-commerce Sites
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Recommender systems have become widely used in various website applications. With the integration of deep learning and recommender systems, the classic Session-based Recommender System (SRS) appears, which can obtain implicit feedback from explicit interactions. Some scholars have pro-posed many effective recommendation algorithms to provide better recommendation service in SRS. In order to compare the performance of these session-based recommendation algorithms, we consider a simple E-commerce SRS scenario and choose four representative session-based recommendation algorithms in this paper. Then we do some evaluation experiments. The experimental results show that the combination of local preferences and global preferences will improve the recommendation performance significantly, and for GNNs and RNN s in session recommendation based on deep learning, we also conclude that the prediction effect of GNN s is slightly superior to RNN s on long sessions.

articleTitle: Research on an evaluation method of rice processing loss
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this article, from the perspective of rice processing loss, this paper proposes a method to evaluate the processing loss of rice produced by enterprises using data analysis. The specific content of this method is to build a fitting simulation model of unit power consumption and rice production rate based on production data of various types of enterprises across the country at different scales, equipment, and technological processes, thereby establishing a rice processing loss evaluation system; Based on the production data of the enterprise to be evaluated, an enterprise data fitting optimization model of unit power consumption and rice production rate was constructed; and the results of evaluation and diagnosis were combined with processing losses of rice processing enterprises. The application process of this evaluation method found the change law of unit power consumption and rice production rate in different dimensions, and gave evaluation conclusions and optimization plans for the evaluation of the production status of the enterprise. The application of this evaluation method to the grain industry can be a rice processing enterprise. Provide practical guidance on energy saving and consumption reduction during processing.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Business-oriented Authority Management in New Generation Power Grid Dispatching and Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This article analyzes the changes of the new generation power grid dispatching and control system in system architecture, human-computer interaction mode, business organization mode, etc., sorts out the new business-oriented requirements for authority management in the new generation of power grid dispatching and control system, and proposes the business-oriented authority management solution in the new generation power grid dispatching and control system, and its key technologies are discussed such as path-based global controlled resource identification definition, metadata-based controlled resource management, multi-factor access control based on rule engine, cross-system access control based on upper and lower organizational relationships. This solution is verified in the prototype system, and provides multi-dimensional resource security access control method for business in the new generation power grid dispatching and control system.

articleTitle: Structural and Modal Analysis of Cross Core Piezomagnetic Resistance Sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety and reliability of the cross core piezomagnetic resistance sensor, the finite element static analysis on the main structure and shell of the sensor was carried out by ANSYS Workbench software, and the stress and deformation distribution of each structure under different external force conditions were studied. The modal analysis of the main structure of the sensor was carried out to study the dynamic characteristics. The natural frequencies and corresponding vibration modes of the first six modes were obtained. The results show that under the given conditions, the sensor structure met the strength requirement, and the stress was concentrated in the groove of its shell. With the increase of external force, the maximum equivalent stress and total deformation of the main structure and shell of the sensor increased linearly, and the deformation of the shell changed rapidly; The calculated natural frequencies of the sensor under different orderscan provide a theoretical basis for its structural dynamic design.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Evaluation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicle’ Path Planning in Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of lack of operation for path guidance in complex scene, difficulty in quantifying evaluation index of path planning, and over idealization of evaluation results, this paper analyzes the common working conditions faced by autonomous underwater vehicle in complex scene, establishes a complete quantitative evaluation index model, uses analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to weight the index, and proposes an improved cloud-gravity-center evaluation method, the expert evaluation method transforms the fixed comment set of cloud model into the quantitative score of path planning' effectiveness in complex scenarios, and improves the A* algorithm based on the energy cost of yawing in the evaluation index model, based on the complex scene, the effectiveness evaluation of the path before and after the improvement of A* algorithm is carried out. The simulation results show that the method is practical in unstructured scene, and the analysis of evaluation results can effectively guide path planning for task of autonomous underwater vehicle, and has high application value.

articleTitle: Design of Primary System for 110kV Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Substation is the bridge between power plant and load, and it is the place where high-quality energy is transported. And China's power technology has been in the world's top level, because of the complex terrain in China, so the design of power station should consider the impact of terrain factors, economic factors, and future development factors and so on. Therefore, smart substation design is worthy of our research and innovation. Installation of lightning arrester can effectively reduce the threat of lightning.

articleTitle: An automated test system for high SNR ADC
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, an automated test system for high SNR ADC is designed and built. Using low noise signal source and reference voltage generator to drive the ADC chip. Test results are readout and uploaded to the data server. A parallel running program processes the data synchronously. An ADC chip with SNR more than 100dB was tested to verify the test system. The accuracy and test efficiency of the test platform architecture can meet most of the research and development requirements.

articleTitle: Analysis of Elderly Inventory of Electricity Meters Based on Association Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: At present, China's economy is developing rapidly and the scale of power grid is constantly expanding. With the continuous deepening of the intensive operation mode of human, financial and physical assets of the power grid companies, intensive management of electricity meters as metering assets has been paid more and more attention. This paper considers properties of electricity meter, which including management unit, status, specification and so on, to carry out association rule mining for the elderly electricity meters. Based on the results of association rules mining, the internal relationship between elderly inventory of electricity meters and management unit, status, specification, warehouse level and other factors was obtained. The analysis result can provide support for the inventory management of electricity meters, reduce inventory age of electricity meters and improve the utilization rate of electricity meters, further reduce losses of human, financial and physical assets.

articleTitle: Research on Magnetic Coupling Mechanism of Underwater Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Underwater wireless charging technology provides a feasible way to solve the problems of poor safety, low life and difficult maintenance of traditional wet plug charging mode of underwater equipment. In this paper, the research status of magnetic coupling mechanism of underwater wireless charging system at home and abroad is reviewed, and the characteristics of different types of magnetic coupling mechanism are studied and analyzed. The problems existing in the research of underwater wireless charging magnetic coupling mechanism are summarized.

articleTitle: An Approach for Improving the Surge of a Distributed Power Grid Containing the Impact Loads by Forecasting Status Classifiers Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to suppress circular current of distributed power grid we have proposed a general approach based on big data theory in this paper. This method includes two stages: the offline identify the status classifiers that described the characteristic of the impact load and the online calculate the drive instruction by comparing sampling data to the classifiers. We utilize big data theory to analyze and forecast the status classifiers of reactive power and harmonic current according to sampled massive data caused by the impact load. The topology of proposed TAPF consists of TSF (Thyristor Switched Filter) and APF (Active Power Filter) is controlled by same DSP2812. Combination rules that include the APF and TSF works individually and these two works together have been given by analyzing status classifiers. The circular current which caused by APF and TSF works together has been suppressed by connecting an extra resistance in series with the channel of TSF. The feasibility and effectiveness of this approach has been illustrated with an injection machine. Experiment and simulation show this approach can suppress the surge caused by the impact loads by which the grid can meet the requirements of national standard GB/T-14549-93.

Author Keywords: BCU (based controlling unstable equilibrium point method)

articleTitle: Analysing Fault Cause of Smart Electricity Meters Based on Association Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's economic and social construction, building a strong smart power grid has become the inevitable trend of future power grid development. As an important infrastructure of the smart power grid, smart electricity meter plays an extremely important role in the development of the smart power grid. The fault of electricity meter is the main reason of electricity meter replacement. In this paper, association rule mining is carried out for the fault cause of electricity meters by using the replacement data of fault meters. Based on the association rules mining, the internal relationship between the electricity meter fault and the electricity meter manufacturer, management unit and other factors is obtained. The mining results can provide support for the formulation of the management scheme of electricity meters, further reduce the failure rate of meters, reduce the risk of public opinion, and improves the operation reliability of smart electricity meters.

articleTitle: Design of omnidirectional positioning buoy based on Fuzzy PID algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low precision and poor anti-jamming ability of traditional buoy control system, it can not meet the requirements of high-density and complex routes. In this paper, an omni-directional positioning buoy is designed. The buoy system mainly uses the fuzzy PID control algorithm theory to improve the buoy automatic positioning accuracy.
