At the same time, ZYNQ is used as the core control chip of the buoy system to realize the integration of positioning, communication, sensor and other modules. In this paper, the traditional PID control system and fuzzy PID control system are simulated and compared by MATLAB. The results show that the marine buoy under Fuzzy PID control has better dynamic characteristics and response speed, which enhances the adaptability of the buoy control system and improves the positioning accuracy of the buoy.

articleTitle: Classification for Time Series of Aerospace Targets with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Aerospace target classification is very important for strategic early warning and defense, and radar cross section (RCS) contains a wealth of information about aerospace targets. Based on RCS, conventional methods for aerospace target classification need to construct artificial features, and there is little explanation for the classification results. In this paper, an intelligent and partly interpretable method is proposed for classifying a swarm of aerospace targets, including cone targets, false targets, engines and so on. The fully convolutional neural network is adopted to extract the features of time series and to achieve the classification of different targets. Moreover, the class activation map is introduced to highlight the subsequences that contribute the most to a certain classification, and Gramian Angular Summation Field is used to visualize the time series and the weights in the neural network. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method for aerospace target classification and analysis.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Frequency Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The development of PMSM is inseparable from the continuous improvement of the performance-to-price ratio of permanent magnet materials and the development of power electronic equipment. This is exactly the study of PMSM. Entered a new stage, PMSM plays an important role in military, industry and daily life. Dating vector control theory to the field of PMSM speed regulation is also a major breakthrough. Researchers combined the mathematical model of PMSM with the vector control model. It is based on this that the PMSM vector control double closed-loop model was established. Simulate in MATLAB software. There are current module, speed module and PMSM main module in the simulation diagram, and then analyze the simulation results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vibration Characteristics of Tracked Vehicle Based on Experimental Tests
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to reveal the mapping relationship between the degradation characteristics and vibration characteristics of tracked vehicle components, a vibration test system is built to test the vibration characteristics of typical positions of tracked vehicle under common driving conditions. Then, the correlation between the vibration value of the test point and the vehicle speed is established by using a logarithmic linear regression model, and the correlation of the vibration between different test points is analyzed. Finally, through mining the vibration characteristics of typical positions of the transmission device, the signal feature that can effectively characterize the degradation trend of the components can be extracted, which is helpful to realize the assessment of vehicle health and failure warning. This research has certain reference value for optimizing the layout of test points and improving the functions of the on-board system of prognostics health management.

articleTitle: Adaptive Test Technology of Temperature Prediction for Units in Start-up State
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Machine learning has been applied to the temperature prediction model. The prediction accuracy of temperature prediction model based on machine learning depends on the number of fault samples. The number of power plant fault samples is limit. And fault samples from different pumped store power station are often not interchangeable. The adaptive generation technology and sensitivity tested technology of fault samples are proposed in this paper. It provides fault samples and test technology for intelligent trend judgment algorithm. The test can completely cover the trend characteristics under fault conditions. The limitation of relying on the fault samples is overcome. The quantitative evaluation for the implementation effect of intelligent technology is achieved. Intelligent technology parameter adjustment, selection of appropriate algorithms and implementation means are provided with index support. The verification of the implementation effect of the intelligent technology is realized in advance to avoid the loss and uncertain influence brought by the verification through the actual project.

articleTitle: Research on M2M device access method based on packet combining competitive and non-competitive
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of things technology, M2M communication traffic volume is also increasing day by day, but the available wireless resources in LTE network are extremely limited, which has caused great pressure on the service quality of H2H users. In order to ensure the service requirements of H2H users, this paper based on the massive delay tolerant device (delay tolerant) access to the cell network, carries out packet access control, and analyzes the number of devices in the group. The results show that it can effectively reduce the access delay of M2M equipment, and can better meet the requirements of access delay when the number of available preambles allocated to M2M device is small.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a miniaturized integrated servo drive component
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: This paper designs and analyzes a drive module suitable for a certain integrated integrated design servo actuator. According to the limited installation space of the product, the combined miniaturization design is carried out, and relevant simulation analysis and experimental research are carried out to guide the The design of similar products has certain guiding significance.

articleTitle: Day-ahead campus load interval forecast based on similar day and kernel function estimation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Presently, most of short-term load forecasting are in form of point forecast. It cannot give the fluctuation range of predicted load. Because of complex characteristics of power system, the larger error of point forecast is resulted by uncertain factors. This paper presents a day-ahead interval forecast based on similar day and kernel density estimation for campus load. Similar day unit decomposes point load forecast into the predictions for daily average load and pre-unit curve. Then, these predictive values are synthesized into load interval by kernel density estimation unit. The reason for selecting kernel density estimation is due to its free-form and independence of the sample distribution, which is more fit for the randomness and volatility of campus load. The simulation results collected from North Carolina State University demonstrate the universality and strong robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Cooperative Fire Extinguishing Technology of Battery Energy Storage Device in Cluster
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The electrochemical energy storage device is equipped with an independent fire extinguishing device and distributed independently. In this paper, a connection pipeline and a bypass solenoid valve are arranged on the fire extinguishing equipment of the electrochemical energy storage device distributed in a distributed manner to connect the fire extinguishing devices into a network. Through the standardized graph theory path selection technology, the automatic detection and control of the fire-extinguishing medium cooling of the fire-extinguishing equipment in each electrochemical energy storage device is realized, which is controlled by the solenoid valve from far to near according to the distance of the connection path. The distributed electrochemical energy storage device does not need to reserve a large margin of gas cylinders, and the distributed cooling device realizes standby mutual benefit and collaborative cooling through this technology, which improves the reliability of the fire-extinguishing device and reduces the cost of fire-extinguishing equipment of the electrochemical energy storage device.

articleTitle: Prediction of Ionospheric Total Electron Content Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: A new prediction model for the total electron content of the global ionosphere is presented by combining the long short-term memory neural network and empirical mode decomposition. The model can predict the total electron content of Nanchang Station up to 24 hours in advance. The experimental results show that the combination model performs well under different experimental conditions, such as the varying modeling time and dependent days. Based on experimental results and assessment criteria, the combination model is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on RSSD and improved multi-population quantum genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the process of resonance sparse signal decomposition, the choice of quality factor has an important influence on the decomposition result. At present, the Resonance Sparse Signal Decomposition (RSSD) mainly relies on the global optimization performance of artificial and genetic algorithms to select quality factors. However, conventional genetic algorithms are prone to fall into local optimal and premature convergence. In order to solve the problems of conventional genetic algorithms, in this paper, an improved multi-population quantum genetic algorithm is proposed to optimize the quality factor in resonance sparse signal decomposition. Compared with the existing methods, this method uses dynamic quantum revolving gates and catastrophic migration functions to adaptively obtain quality factors that match the characteristics of the original signal. Applying our proposed method to the early fault diagnosis of rolling bearings, the frequency amplitude of the fault signal obtained is about 50% higher than that of the traditional algorithm, and the resolution is improved, which can accurately and effectively extract the fault characteristic information in the vibration signal.

articleTitle: R-PMA: Rapid & Efficient Statistical Reporting on Heterogeneous Resources
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In contemporary organizations, different units of the corporation use a diverse system to produce, save, and search their important data. However, these enterprises synchronize the diversified data of these different systems to understand the full value of the data. Data federation is an approach to integrate the data of heterogeneous data sources. R-PMA is a web-based reporting tool, that federates the heterogeneous data sources e.g. RDF, Relational Databases, and text data in different formats. R-PMA imports all features of datasets and builds interactive reports, based on the imported data resources. It can interact with sparkR for statistical analysis of large datasets. R- PMA also provides an SQL interface to query SparkSQL and MySQL for procuring the required information for reporting. Finally, we have developed it as a plugin in PHPMy Admin to facilitate the organizations that have been using rational databases for years.

articleTitle: Usability study of auditory feedback and visual feedback in an immersive virtual assembly system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, we evaluate the usability of auditory feedback and visual feedback in an immersive virtual assembly system which is designed for mechanical engineering teaching. We choose task accomplished or not, rate of task accomplishment, time of task accomplishment, lostness, and user subjective satisfaction as the usability measurement indicators. Usability tests are carried out under four conditions: no feedback, visual feedback, auditory feedback and multichannel feedback. Experimental results show that multichannel feedback and visual feedback are more effective to virtual assembly system. Furthermore, we select multi-channel feedback in learning effect experiments, and compare the immersive virtual assembly training with real assembly environment training. The experimental results show that virtual assembly training with multi-channel feedback has obvious learning effect. but is significantly worse than real assembly training, and the time of virtual assembly training is significantly higher than that of real assembly training. The research results of this paper have certain guiding effect on the design and application of virtual assembly system.

articleTitle: DCCH: Deep Continuous Center Hashing for Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Existing hash methods only compare the hash codes by the similarity of hash codes, which cannot fully express the relationship of between the hash codes corresponding to images. This work improves the quality of image retrieval by end-to-end representation learning. We propose a compact hash code learning method named DCCH (Deep Continuous Center Hashing), which learns hash representation with a well-specified loss function which adopts label information and spatial information. We train deep network model with proposed loss function to improve image hashing and video hashing. Experiments on image hashing and video hashing demonstrate that proposed DCCH method yields higher mean average precision than state-of-the-art hashing approaches.

articleTitle: Research on real-time monitoring technology of asphalt pavement thickness based on GPR
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, a ground penetrating radar (GPR) system with a single host, multiple channels and high economic efficiency is established, and the GPR is moved forward from the necessary post-construction inspection means to be combined with the asphalt paver, using radar wave feedback data to obtain the real time loose laying thickness during paving process, guide the paving operation, correct abnormal paving in time, and effectively control the amount of asphalt mixture, which has great practical significance and economic benefits for reducing construction costs and improving pavement quality.

articleTitle: Pitch angle accuracy improvement method based on multi-radar cooperation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: When radar tracks low altitude target, the error of pitch angle measurement is large. To solve the problem, this paper proposes three methods to improve the accuracy of pitch angle measurement with multi-radar cooperation. With Gaussian mixture algorithm, we can get pitch angle immediately, and this method can effectively improve the measurement accuracy of pitch angle.

articleTitle: An Invoice Recognition System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a deep learning base batch invoice recognition system, obtaining highly accurate recognition for value-added tax (VAT) invoice. Invoices are scanned in batch and imported into computer to derive raw images, with which our work proceeds in the following steps: 1) raw images are normalized; 2) we improve the character segmentation by the projection algorithm according to location information in template matching algorithm; 3) convolutional neural network (CNN) was further adopted for character recognition; 4) we introduce a module for judgment and manual modification, which estimates recognition considering the association of invoice contents, and then the wrong recognized invoice is modified to improve the system's fault tolerance; 5) the correct information is recorded. Empirical results show that the location algorithm based on template matching is most suitable for the invoice system among several tested algorithms. The application of deep learning technology to character recognition ensures the recognition accuracy. The performance of the entire system was also evaluated with random invoices. The proposed system, with the aid of the manual modification, can reach 100% recognition rate.

articleTitle: An Approach Based on Situation Analysis and Separation of Environment Perception to Implement Adaptive Strategies
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In the existing research, most software adaptation is triggered by changes in the environment. However, the environment of a software system is characterized by uncertainty and complexity. For a software system, the same situation is reflected by different kinds of data in different environments. Unfortunately, traditional adaptive strategies can only be applied to specific environments. When the environment changes, the adaptive strategy also changes accordingly. At the same time, the existing adaptive strategies lack intuition. Therefore, the problem to be solved is how to simplify the specification and implementation of adaptive logic, while ensuring that the software system can adapt to a variety of deployment environments, and also tolerate the uncertainty in the environment. To solve the above problems, we propose our method, an adaptive strategy implementation method based on situation analysis and separation of environment perception. Our method is implemented by the MAPE-K loop, we consider the similar environmental states as one kind of situation in general, and then the adaptive strategy in this situation is defined. It separates the specific environmental data from the adaptive logic of how the software adapts to different situations. Besides, this paper also provides a case study - Intelligent Medical Assistance System to evaluate the feasibility and effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Manufacturer and authenticity identification of Chinese Ejiao based on laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy and machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In this paper, a method combining LIBS technology and machine learning algorithms was proposed to identify Ejiao rapidly and accurately. The experiment was divided into sample preparation, spectra acquisition, data preprocessing, feature selection, model training and model evaluation. Several Ejiao samples from different Ejiao manufacturers were collected, and there were two fake samples made by illegal manufacturers. All the samples were appropriately cut without other processing. The LIBS spectra of these samples were detected in the wavelength from 200 nm to 430 nm. Noise removal and intensity normalization were carried out; then the PCA method was used to select the features. Machine learning algorithms like SVM, RF and ANN were used to build the Ejiao identification model, and the model performance was evaluated to explore the feasibility of using the LIBS spectrum to label Ejiao. The result showed that, for the Ejiao manufacturer identification problem, the best model accuracy of the three algorithms is 96.67%, 96.19% and 97.62% respectively; for the Ejiao authenticity identification problem, good model performance was obtained, for instance, the average Fl-measure for the three methods was 98.33 %. It also showed that the model performance would be further improved as the size of the training data set increased. The ANN algorithm obtained the best model performance, and the manufacturer identification accuracy was 98.57%, and the authenticity identification Fl-measure was 99.01%. The result indicated that our method could establish a practicable model for the manufacturer and authenticity identification of Ejiao.

articleTitle: HeadCap: A Hierarchical Encoder-And-Decoder Image Captioning Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Image captioning achieves its goal by two steps traditionally, it first extracts image features using deep networks, and then translates the features into correct text descriptions. Though recent compelling captioning results have surged continuously, the bridge between visual cues and texts is usually limited by weak single-layer CNN features and one-word one-attention strategy. In this paper, we propose a simple yet effective Hierarchical Encoder-And-Decoder image CAPtioning model (HeadCap) to capture visual cues across different levels whilst conducting one-word multi-attention scheme in a unified hierarchical architecture. In specific, we collect multi-layer features from feature pyramid network (FPN), which allows stringing visual features across different levels hierarchically. More importantly, a multi-attention LSTM module (mLSTM) is established on such hierarchical features, which performs multiple attentions over hierarchical features progressively when predicting a word. This provides LSTM more attention chance to reduce the risk of the mismatch between visual cues and texts, and further to bridge the gap between each other. Experiments on MSCOCO image captioning dataset show that HeadCap yields favorable performance against several well-behaved deep captioning models.

articleTitle: Power Quality Comprehensive Evaluation Method for Wind-Solar-Battery Power System Based on Improved FAHP-GRA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: With the development of wind-solar-battery power system and the increasingly strict requirements of consumers for power quality, it is of great significance to evaluate the power quality of wind-solar-battery power system both accurately and comprehensively. This paper constructs the evaluation index system of power quality applicable to the wind-solar-battery power system. On this basis, it establishes a comprehensive evaluation model based on the fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) and improved grey relational analysis (GRA). The model takes the existing experience into account during the decision-making process, integrating the index value coefficient into the objective correlation degree. While introducing the adjustment strategy of dynamic resolution coefficient, this model makes up for the shortcomings of the traditional grey relational analysis, and realizes the good combination of subjective expert experience and objective node data. Finally, a case study was provided to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Recognition Technology of Automatic Charging and Pressing for Fuze Initiating Explosive Device
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Fuze is a control system (or device) that uses target, environment or command information to release arming under predetermined conditions and detonate or ignite the charge of ammunition warhead at favorable time or position. Ammunition is the core part of weapon system and the final means to complete the given combat task. As the control system (or device) of the ammunition warhead which produces damage effect or terminal effect on the target, fuze is always in the forefront of terminal confrontation of weapons and ammunition battlefield. A large number of actual combat cases show that the fuze with perfect performance and reliable quality can ensure the ammunition warhead to effectively damage the target. This paper puts forward the project design of automatic charging and pressing system for fuze initiating explosive device in an initiating explosive device factory. The design of the project is to establish a new charging and pressing system, which can automatically identify the charge height, charge density, charge pressure and other parameters in the assembly process of fuze pyrotechnic products, and automatically eliminate the unqualified products, so as to replace the backward fully manual equipment.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Web Honeypot Detection System Based on Search Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In these years, with the development of search engines, it is more convenient for people to get information via the Internet. However, despite the benefit, search engines bring new challenges to network security. More and more hackers search for vulnerable websites and computers with the help of search engines and make large-scale attacks. This is quite a challenge to traditional cybersecurity concepts. Honeypot is a technology that is widely used in capturing and analyzing hackers' behaviors. By building virtual objectives with vulnerabilities, honeypots attract hackers and analyze the interaction process with hackers. But traditional honeypot can't attract hackers well and just wait for attackers. We design and implement a new Web honeypot detection system based on search engines, which can not only attract hackers but also can renew the content automotive to synchronize with the new attack technologies. This new kind of honeypot makes up for the shortcomings of traditional honeypots and has great advantages in finding zero-day attacks.

articleTitle: Automatic Segmentation of Metastasis Lesions in SPECT Bone Scan Images
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: SPECT bone imaging is among the main nuclear medicine functional imaging modalities, which has the potential of early diagnosis of various serious diseases such as cancers. However, the low resolution and contrast of SPECT bone images bring huge challenges to performance on segmenting hotspots or lesions in SPECT bone scan images. In this work, three different algorithms including K-means clustering method, region growth method and C- V model are introduced to segment lesions in SPECT bone scan images by fine-tuning parameters, focusing on the bone metastatic lesions area in SPECT imaging. Specifically, each of the original 256 × 1024 whole body images is cropped into a 256 × 256 thoracic region including ribs and spine, followed by the data normalization. Then, different parameters are experimentally determined for the above three algorithms, leading to three different segmentation algorithms. Last, experimental evaluation conducted on a group of real-world samples of SPECT bone scan images reveals that our methods are workable for segmenting lesions with SPECT imaging, obtaining a value of 0.7307, 0.7768 and 0.8076 for Tanimoto similarity coefficient metric by the three methods, respectively. Particularly, the C- V model based segmentation method is able to provide more assistive information for oncologists on diagnose of tumors and other related diseases.

articleTitle: An efficient multi-scaled super resolution framework for image enhancement
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In recent years, the super-resolution (SR) technique achieved impressive results by using a deep convolutional neural network (CNN). Generally, deep CNNs networks can extract better feature maps and reconstruct high-resolution (HR) images. However, a wider and deeper network increases complexity and computation time for any real-time applications. It is essential to develop a lightweight network for useful SR images that have less computation time and complexity. In this paper, we proposed multi-scale residual blocks based network for single image super-resolution. The multi-scale layers are effectively utilized in the model for feature extraction and reconstruct high-resolution(HR) images with less computation time and complexity. We try to find out an optimal point for image quality and computational time. In comparison to others, the optimal point of our model is (100.7) greater than other state-of-the-art CNN models.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Imputation Method for Electricity Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: The missing daily frozen forward active energy data in electricity energy data acquisition system will affect electricity analysis and electricity charge calculations. To solve the problem, this paper proposes an intelligent electricity data imputation method based on electricity data on same period and average electricity data in the same industries. To find the date on same period, matching algorithm of similar date and distance function of dates are proposed. The results show that during Spring Festival, May Day, National Day and non-holidays, for the two subdivisions of no daily frozen data at the end and daily frozen data at the end, the intelligent electricity data imputation method is better than the transaction imputation method and arithmetic average method. Besides, the standard error of intelligent electricity data imputation method is reduced by 34.43% and 28.25% compared to the transaction imputation method and the arithmetic average method respectively.

articleTitle: Use of data-driven model analysis to develop raw material quality standards for frozen dumplings
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: In order to enable companies to directly infer the quality standard of the requisite frozen dumpling ingredients based on the quality of the frozen dumplings, this paper proposes a data-driven model-based analysis method. The method firstly studies the core indicators and main components of glutinous rice flour through data analysis, and secondly uses the core indicators and main components of glutinous rice flour to predict the quality indicators of instant frozen dumplings. Then the upper and lower bounds of the range of variation of the core indicators of glutinous rice flour are used as decision variables, and the quality requirements of frozen soup dumplings and glutinous rice flour itself are used as constraints to find the region of the range of variation of the indicators that are dedicated to glutinous rice flour as widely as possible. Finally, we adjusted the model, and the optimal range of glutinous rice flour indexes included almost all raw materials with high sensory score in the sample data, and solved the problem of setting quality standards for special glutinous rice flour.

articleTitle: High precision positioning technology based on commercial relay satellite
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Computing, Automation and Systems (ICICAS)
abstract: Although GPS, BeiDou and other systems have greatly improved their positioning accuracy and coverage, non-GNSS navigation and positioning technology is still a hot issue in the application scenarios of GNSS terminal denial of communication in the combat environment. This paper proposes a transmission satellite navigation system based on relay satellites, which hides the navigation signal with very low power spectrum in the host signal and transparently forwards it to the terminal via the relay satellite. This technology can provide a kind of concealed and minimal navigation service by using civil communication satellite. At the same time, for the case of deep spread spectrum, an efficient waveform design suitable for fast acquisition is proposed, that is, using Chirp-Noise Waveform (CNW) signal with time-frequency coupling characteristics to replace the traditional Pseudo-Noise (PN) code. Finally, the positioning accuracy and simulation verification are analyzed. Simulation results show that the system can achieve two-dimensional positioning accuracy of centimeter level.
